extraction_notes: Scanned PDF with no text layer; every value was transcribed from the page images (pypdf-extracted JPEGs). The report names the system 'Emerald Estates Mutual Water Company' whereas Drinking Water Watch and the 2024 report call it Emerald Valley Mutual Water Company (same wells EVE-1/EVE-2 at 999 Melchoir Ct. and same contact), so it is taken to be the same system. The title and sample dates are 2025 but the 'About This Report' boilerplate says the monitoring period is January 1 to December 31, 2024 (not updated); data_year recorded as 2025. Tables 3-5 give one row per well (EVE-1, EVE-2); source_group names the well. Nitrate and EVE-2 iron 'Level Detected' are printed as ranges, so value is the range high. The iron unit is printed as 'ppm' against an SMCL of 300 (ppb standard) and is copied as printed; EVE-2 iron 680 exceeds the SMCL but Table 7 says 'None'. The lead/copper table is unfilled template placeholders and the E. coli detections cell reads '2025'. Fluoride PHG printed '.1'. Table 6 (unregulated) is empty; Tables 10-11 and the RTCR section on pages 7-10 are unfilled template text.
